name: Wallpaper Rotate
author: contra
description: Rotate the desktop background through the current theme's wallpapers on a timer. One shell timer and no polling: nothing runs between rotations, and it skips while the screen is locked.

barWidget.description: Rotate through the current theme's wallpapers. Click for next, middle-click for previous, right-click to pause.

schema.label: Shuffle
schema.description: Pick a random wallpaper each time instead of going in order.

schema.label: Hold on battery
schema.description: Do not rotate on a timer while unplugged. Clicking still works.
